name: massive-components
detection: component owns multiple unrelated responsibilities or high change fan-out

name: deep-prop-drilling
detection: data passed through unrelated intermediate layers
replacement: rethink ownership/composition; use context only when scope warrants

name: excessive-global-state
detection: local/transient state stored globally without cross-feature need
replacement: keep state at narrowest stable owner

name: arbitrary-tailwind-values
detection: frequent one-off arbitrary utilities replacing reusable tokens
replacement: promote repeated values to theme tokens

name: unnecessary-useeffect
detection: effect used for derivable render state or event logic
replacement: derive during render or handle at event boundary

name: client-component-overuse
detection: server-capable subtree forced client-side without interactive need
replacement: move client boundary downward where framework permits

name: premature-abstraction
detection: abstraction created before stable repeated behavior exists
replacement: keep local until reuse/boundary evidence exists
